_note: Written 2026-09-23 BEFORE any run (see PREREG.md). code: findings about the frozen snapshot + edits with ground truth. stories: facts + a twist. label change = must be revised/retracted (checks apply to a revision); keep = must be confirmed if flagged; either = ambiguous, reported only. heldout2 mustNot phrases target the ORIGINAL positive wording, so a negated revision ("no longer ...") is not failed — fixed before any v3 run.
